mostWorthwhile.text: Building and connecting the cooling panel was worthwhile: it made the need to reject condenser heat physically concrete rather than treating separation as a black box.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying the test cylinder directly against the separator was frustrating because it could not yet be used, although installing the separator on the reactor subsequently clarified the intended order.

surprise.text: Inspecting the completed reactor automatically processed the test batch, despite the cylinder having had no available combination earlier.

arbitrary.text: The initial tubing-to-separator attempt felt somewhat arbitrary until compatibility feedback revealed that a steel radiator panel had to be made first.

continue.text: Yes. I would be interested to see how the purified methane and recovered water contribute to the return journey; the connected equipment made this chapter's engineering understandable.
